Day-1 observations

Transpiration rate (TR) and stomatal conductance (gsw) responses to stepped VPD levels in 14 soybean genotypes across five WUE phenotype classes. Three model types fitted to Day-1 data and compared by AIC.

Transpiration rate (TR) models

Models fitted per genotype (Day-1 data, Rep as random effect via nlme):

  • Linear: TR = a + b·VPD
  • Bilinear: two slopes joined at a breakpoint BP
  • Linear plateau: linear increase then flat at TRₘₐₓ (classic LT response)

Fig 1 - All models per genotype

Fig. 1. TR vs VPD per genotype. Points coloured by WUE class. All three model curves shown; bold = best model by AIC. Inverted triangles mark estimated breakpoints.

Fig 2 - Pooled by WUE class

Fig. 2. TR vs VPD by WUE class. Thin = per-genotype best model; thick = pooled OLS ±95% CI.

Fig 3 - Breakpoint VPD

Fig. 3. Estimated breakpoint VPD for genotypes with non-linear best model. Dashed line at 1.73 kPa (literature LT breakpoint).

Fig 4 - Transpiration sensitivity (Slope₁)

Fig. 4. Initial slope of TR vs VPD per genotype. Higher = greater sensitivity to VPD in the linear range.

Fig 6 - AIC model comparison

Fig. 6. ΔAIC heatmap. Red = best model (ΔAIC = 0).

Fig 7 - TR mean ± SD per genotype

Fig. 7. Transpiration rate: genotype mean +/- SD across replicates per VPD treatment. Each symbol = one genotype; error bars = 1 SD across replicates.

Stomatal conductance (gsw) models

gsw (mol m⁻² s⁻¹) measured with LICOR for 9 of 14 genotypes on Day 1 (41 observations). Mean of three LICOR readings used.

Fig 5 - gsw per genotype

Fig. 5. Stomatal conductance vs VPD per genotype. Points show the three individual LICOR readings per plant; model curve fitted to the per-plant mean. Negative slopes indicate stomatal closure in response to increasing VPD.

Fig 8 - gsw mean ± SD per genotype

Fig. 8. Stomatal conductance: genotype mean +/- SD across the 3 LICOR readings per VPD treatment. Each symbol = one genotype; error bars = 1 SD across the three LICOR readings.

Methods summary

Data

Source: data/data_all.xlsx (sheet "dataAll"). 491 observations, 14 genotypes, 4 replicates, 2 days, 6 VPD treatments. TR (mg m⁻² s⁻¹) = (Initial − Final weight) × 1000 / (leaf area m² × duration s).

Model fitting

Day-1 data only. Random effect: Rep (replicate) fitted via nlme::lme() for the linear model and nlme::nlme() for bilinear and linear-plateau models (nls fallback when nlme fails to converge). Model selection by AIC.

Scripts

  • script/01_data_inspection_QC.R — data loading, QC, diagnostic figures
  • script/02_model_fitting_TR_gs_VPD.R — model fitting, publication figures, parameter tables
  • script/03_generate_report.R — this HTML report
